name: flow_difficulty_member_follows_the_leader
description: A member's level is the party's (M8, contract-m8 §3; design 5.2): I join Ana's party at Normal with my profile at Very Hard; the hub shows the party's level, not mine; my own pick changes only my profile and sends nothing (the leader picks); Ana's Hard reaches me and clears my Ready, and a Try of mine plays the level the hub shows (Hard); a PARTY difficulty a member sends anyway is answered to her alone with the party as it is (one PARTY_STATE to her, none to the leader, and her session takes it in); once Ana leaves I lead a party of one at the party's level, and my pick then goes to the server.

steps.msg: in Ana's party the hub shows the party's level, Normal; my profile keeps Very Hard
joining sends no level: the party's is the leader's

steps.assert: Session.difficulty_id() == 'normal' and Session.profile.difficulty == 'hard' and not seq.party_log.has([1, 'difficulty'])
steps.msg: a member's pick changes only the profile and sends nothing
the leader's change cleared my Ready
a Try plays the level the hub shows: the party's
a member's PARTY difficulty, sent anyway, is answered to her alone: one PARTY_STATE to me, none to Ana

steps.assert: int(Session.party['at']) > before[2] and Session.difficulty_id() == 'hard' and int(seq.party['difficulty']) == 1
steps.msg: the answer reaches my session, and it is the party as it is: still Hard
leading a party of one now, the party's level stays
the leader's pick goes to the server
